goldens.comment: The rendered GrafanaRuleListItem is missing the required key prop for React list items. This can cause rendering issues when the list order changes.
goldens.reasoning: C1 points out the same missing key on GrafanaRuleListItem.

goldens.comment: RuleActionsButtons is invoked with only promRule, but SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer inside RuleActionsButtons still depends on a Grafana Ruler rule being present, so for Grafana rules coming from list views the 'Silence notifications' menu entry (now driven by Grafana Prom abilities) will toggle showSilenceDrawer without ever rendering the drawer. This means clicking 'Silence notifications' for these rules has no visible effect, even when abilities indicate silencing is allowed.
goldens.reasoning: C2 describes the same problem: Silence notifications can appear but opens no drawer because no Ruler rule is available.

candidates: FilterViewResults renders GrafanaRuleListItem in a rules.map(...) branch without a React key, unlike other branches. This causes React warnings and can lead to incorrect component state reuse when the filtered list changes.

In the list-view path that no longer fetches Ruler rules, AlertRuleMenu can enable Grafana Prom-rule abilities (Silence/Delete) but the surrounding components still require a Ruler rule to execute/render those actions. 'Silence notifications' can appear but opens no drawer, and 'Delete' can be permitted but never rendered.

GrafanaGroupLoader calls .map() on promResponse.data.groups.at(0)?.rules without optional-chaining rules. If the API returns an empty groups array, this becomes undefined.map(...) and crashes the view.
